stepper.$description: Horizontal step indicator for a short multi-step flow — the New Group Message wizard ('1 Select Students — 2 Message Details') is its driving use case. Numbered circles joined by connector lines, each step inactive / active / complete. A complete step's circle fills and swaps its number for a check; the connector leading INTO a reached step fills too, so progress reads left-to-right. Deliberately minimal (no vertical variant, no descriptions) — built for 2–3 step wizards, not a page-length onboarding.

iconSize.$description: The check glyph on a complete step (check.svg, the shared Material icon).

completeColor.$description: The connector into a reached step fills brand blue.

text.$description: The step label beside the circle (14px semibold).

inactive.$description: Not yet reached — a hollow-reading gray disc + muted ink.

active.$description: The current step — solid brand fill, on-fill number, default-ink label.

complete.$description: A finished step — solid brand fill with a check glyph, default-ink label. Same fill as active (it stays 'done and reachable'); the check vs. number is the only difference.
